**`lib/dependencies/CommonJsFullRequireDependency.js`** — CommonJsFullRequireDependency(class), ModuleDependency(constant), constructor(method), getReferencedExports(method), serialize(method), deserialize(method), type(method), category(method)

```javascript
6	"use strict";
7	
8	const Template = require("../Template");
9	const { equals } = require("../util/ArrayHelpers");
10	const { getTrimmedIdsAndRange } = require("../util/chainedImports");
11	const makeSerializable = require("../util/makeSerializable");
12	const propertyAccess = require("../util/propertyAccess");
13	const ModuleDependency = require("./ModuleDependency");
14	
15	/** @typedef {import("webpack-sources").ReplaceSource} ReplaceSource */
16	/** @typedef {import("../Dependency")} Dependency */
17	/** @typedef {import("../Dependency").ReferencedExport} ReferencedExport */
18	/** @typedef {import("../DependencyTemplate").DependencyTemplateContext} DependencyTemplateContext */
19	/** @typedef {import("../ModuleGraph")} ModuleGraph */
20	/** @typedef {import("../javascript/JavascriptParser").Range} Range */
21	/** @typedef {import("../serialization/ObjectMiddleware").ObjectDeserializerContext} ObjectDeserializerContext */
22	/** @typedef {import("../serialization/ObjectMiddleware").ObjectSerializerContext} ObjectSerializerContext */
23	/** @typedef {import("../util/runtime").RuntimeSpec} RuntimeSpec */
24	
25	class CommonJsFullRequireDependency extends ModuleDependency {
26		/**
27		 * @param {string} request the request string
28		 * @param {Range} range location in source code
29		 * @param {string[]} names accessed properties on module
30		 * @param {Range[]=} idRanges ranges for members of ids; the two arrays are right-aligned
31		 */
32		constructor(
33			request,
34			range,
35			names,
36			idRanges /* TODO webpack 6 make this non-optional. It must always be set to properly trim ids. */
37		) {
38			super(request);
39			this.range = range;
40			this.names = names;
41			this.idRanges = idRanges;
42			this.call = false;
43			this.asiSafe = undefined;
44		}
45	
46		/**
47		 * Returns list of exports referenced by this dependency
48		 * @param {ModuleGraph} moduleGraph module graph
49		 * @param {RuntimeSpec} runtime the runtime for which the module is analysed
50		 * @returns {(string[] | ReferencedExport)[]} referenced exports
51		 */
52		getReferencedExports(moduleGraph, runtime) {
53			if (this.call) {
54				const importedModule = moduleGraph.getModule(this);
55				if (
56					!importedModule ||
57					importedModule.getExportsType(moduleGraph, false) !== "namespace"
58				) {
59					return [this.names.slice(0, -1)];
60				}
61			}
62			return [this.names];
63		}
64	
65		/**
66		 * @param {ObjectSerializerContext} context context
67		 */
68		serialize(context) {
69			const { write } = context;
70			write(this.names);
71			write(this.idRanges);
72			write(this.call);
73			write(this.asiSafe);
74			super.serialize(context);
75		}
76	
77		/**
78		 * @param {ObjectDeserializerContext} context context
79		 */
80		deserialize(context) {
81			const { read } = context;
82			this.names = read();
83			this.idRanges = read();
84			this.call = read();
85			this.asiSafe = read();
86			super.deserialize(context);
87		}
88	
89		get type() {
90			return "cjs full require";
91		}
92	
93		get category() {
94			return "commonjs";
95		}
96	}
97	
98	CommonJsFullRequireDependency.Template = class CommonJsFullRequireDependencyTemplate extends (
99		ModuleDependency.Template
100	) {
101		/**
102		 * @param {Dependency} dependency the dependency for which the template should be applied
103		 * @param {ReplaceSource} source the current replace source which can be modified
104		 * @param {DependencyTemplateContext} templateContext the context object
105		 * @returns {void}
106		 */
107		apply(
108			dependency,
109			source,
110			{ runtimeTemplate, moduleGraph, chunkGraph, runtimeRequirements, runtime }
111		) {
112			const dep = /** @type {CommonJsFullRequireDependency} */ (dependency);
113			if (!dep.range) return;
114			const importedModule = moduleGraph.getModule(dep);
115			let requireExpr = runtimeTemplate.moduleExports({
116				module: importedModule,
117				chunkGraph,
118				request: dep.request,
119				weak: dep.weak,
120				runtimeRequirements
121			});
122	
123			const {
124				trimmedRange: [trimmedRangeStart, trimmedRangeEnd],
125				trimmedIds
126			} = getTrimmedIdsAndRange(
127				dep.names,
128				dep.range,
129				dep.idRanges,
130				moduleGraph,
131				dep
132			);
133	
134			if (importedModule) {
135				const usedImported = moduleGraph
136					.getExportsInfo(importedModule)
137					.getUsedName(trimmedIds, runtime);
138				if (usedImported) {
139					const comment = equals(usedImported, trimmedIds)
140						? ""
141						: `${Template.toNormalComment(propertyAccess(trimmedIds))} `;
142					const access = `${comment}${propertyAccess(usedImported)}`;
143					requireExpr =
144						dep.asiSafe === true
145							? `(${requireExpr}${access})`
146							: `${requireExpr}${access}`;
147				}
148			}
149			source.replace(trimmedRangeStart, trimmedRangeEnd - 1, requireExpr);
150		}
151	};
152	
153	makeSerializable(
154		CommonJsFullRequireDependency,
155		"webpack/lib/dependencies/CommonJsFullRequireDependency"
156	);
157	
158	module.exports = CommonJsFullRequireDependency;
```

**`lib/dependencies/CommonJsExportsParserPlugin.js`** — addDependency(calls), push(calls), evaluateExpression(calls), isStatementLevelExpression(calls), slice(calls), CommonJsExportsDependency(instantiates), walkExpression(calls), bailout(calls), formatLocation(calls), parseRequireCall(function), getVariableInfo(calls), constructor(method), apply(method), isTruthyLiteral(calls), getOptimizationBailout(calls), +9 more

```javascript
96	 * @param {Expression} expr expression
97	 * @returns {{ argument: BasicEvaluatedExpression, ids: string[] } | undefined} parsed call
98	 */
99	const parseRequireCall = (parser, expr) => {
100		const ids = [];
101		while (expr.type === "MemberExpression") {
102			if (expr.object.type === "Super") return;
103			if (!expr.property) return;
104			const prop = expr.property;
105			if (expr.computed) {
106				if (prop.type !== "Literal") return;
107				ids.push(`${prop.value}`);
108			} else {
109				if (prop.type !== "Identifier") return;
110				ids.push(prop.name);
111			}
112			expr = expr.object;
113		}
114		if (expr.type !== "CallExpression" || expr.arguments.length !== 1) return;
115		const callee = expr.callee;
116		if (
117			callee.type !== "Identifier" ||
118			parser.getVariableInfo(callee.name) !== "require"
119		) {
120			return;
121		}
122		const arg = expr.arguments[0];
123		if (arg.type === "SpreadElement") return;
124		const argValue = parser.evaluateExpression(arg);
125		return { argument: argValue, ids: ids.reverse() };
126	};
127	
128	const PLUGIN_NAME = "CommonJsExportsParserPlugin";
129	
130	class CommonJsExportsParserPlugin {
131		/**
132		 * @param {ModuleGraph} moduleGraph module graph
133		 */
134		constructor(moduleGraph) {
135			this.moduleGraph = moduleGraph;
136		}
137	
138		/**
139		 * @param {JavascriptParser} parser the parser
140		 * @returns {void}
141		 */
142		apply(parser) {
143			const enableStructuredExports = () => {
144				DynamicExports.enable(parser.state);
145			};
146	
147			/**
148			 * @param {boolean} topLevel true, when the export is on top level
149			 * @param {string[]} members members of the export
150			 * @param {Expression | undefined} valueExpr expression for the value
151			 * @returns {void}
152			 */
153			const checkNamespace = (topLevel, members, valueExpr) => {
154				if (!DynamicExports.isEnabled(parser.state)) return;
155				if (members.length > 0 && members[0] === "__esModule") {
156					if (valueExpr && isTruthyLiteral(valueExpr) && topLevel) {
157						DynamicExports.setFlagged(parser.state);
158					} else {
159						DynamicExports.setDynamic(parser.state);
160					}
161				}
162			};
163			/**
164			 * @param {string=} reason reason
165			 */
166			const bailout = (reason) => {
167				DynamicExports.bailout(parser.state);
168				if (reason) bailoutHint(reason);
169			};
170			/**
171			 * @param {string} reason reason
172			 */
173			const bailoutHint = (reason) => {
174				this.moduleGraph
175					.getOptimizationBailout(parser.state.module)
176					.push(`CommonJS bailout: ${reason}`);
177			};
178	
179			// metadata //
180			parser.hooks.evaluateTypeof
181				.for("module")
182				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, evaluateToString("object"));
183			parser.hooks.evaluateTypeof
184				.for("exports")
185				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, evaluateToString("object"));
186	
187			// exporting //
188	
189			/**
190			 * @param {AssignmentExpression} expr expression
191			 * @param {CommonJSDependencyBaseKeywords} base commonjs base keywords
192			 * @param {string[]} members members of the export
193			 * @returns {boolean | undefined} true, when the expression was handled
194			 */
195			const handleAssignExport = (expr, base, members) => {
196				if (HarmonyExports.isEnabled(parser.state)) return;
197				// Handle reexporting
198				const requireCall = parseRequireCall(parser, expr.right);
199				if (
200					requireCall &&
201					requireCall.argument.isString() &&
202					(members.length === 0 || members[0] !== "__esModule")
203				) {
204					enableStructuredExports();
205					// It's possible to reexport __esModule, so we must convert to a dynamic module
206					if (members.length === 0) DynamicExports.setDynamic(parser.state);
207					const dep = new CommonJsExportRequireDependency(
208						/** @type {Range} */ (expr.range),
209						null,
210						base,
211						members,
212						/** @type {string} */ (requireCall.argument.string),
213						requireCall.ids,
214						!parser.isStatementLevelExpression(expr)
215					);
216					dep.loc = /** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc);
217					dep.optional = Boolean(parser.scope.inTry);
218					parser.state.module.addDependency(dep);
219					return true;
220				}
221				if (members.length === 0) return;
222				enableStructuredExports();
223				const remainingMembers = members;
224				checkNamespace(
225					/** @type {StatementPath} */
226					(parser.statementPath).length === 1 &&
227						parser.isStatementLevelExpression(expr),
228					remainingMembers,
229					expr.right
230				);
231				const dep = new CommonJsExportsDependency(
232					/** @type {Range} */ (expr.left.range),
233					null,
234					base,
235					remainingMembers
236				);
237				dep.loc = /** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc);
238				parser.state.module.addDependency(dep);
239				parser.walkExpression(expr.right);
240				return true;
241			};
242			parser.hooks.assignMemberChain
243				.for("exports")
244				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) =>
245					handleAssignExport(expr, "exports", members)
246				);
247			parser.hooks.assignMemberChain
248				.for("this")
249				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
250					if (!parser.scope.topLevelScope) return;
251					return handleAssignExport(expr, "this", members);
252				});
253			parser.hooks.assignMemberChain
254				.for("module")
255				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
256					if (members[0] !== "exports") return;
257					return handleAssignExport(expr, "module.exports", members.slice(1));
258				});
259			parser.hooks.call
260				.for("Object.defineProperty")
261				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expression) => {
262					const expr = /** @type {CallExpression} */ (expression);
263					if (!parser.isStatementLevelExpression(expr)) return;
264					if (expr.arguments.length !== 3) return;
265					if (expr.arguments[0].type === "SpreadElement") return;
266					if (expr.arguments[1].type === "SpreadElement") return;
267					if (expr.arguments[2].type === "SpreadElement") return;
268					const exportsArg = parser.evaluateExpression(expr.arguments[0]);
269					if (!exportsArg.isIdentifier()) return;
270					if (
271						exportsArg.identifier !== "exports" &&
272						exportsArg.identifier !== "module.exports" &&
273						(exportsArg.identifier !== "this" || !parser.scope.topLevelScope)
274					) {
275						return;
276					}
277					const propertyArg = parser.evaluateExpression(expr.arguments[1]);
278					const property = propertyArg.asString();
279					if (typeof property !== "string") return;
280					enableStructuredExports();
281					const descArg = expr.arguments[2];
282					checkNamespace(
283						/** @type {StatementPath} */
284						(parser.statementPath).length === 1,
285						[property],
286						getValueOfPropertyDescription(descArg)
287					);
288					const dep = new CommonJsExportsDependency(
289						/** @type {Range} */ (expr.range),
290						/** @type {Range} */ (expr.arguments[2].range),
291						`Object.defineProperty(${exportsArg.identifier})`,
292						[property]
293					);
294					dep.loc = /** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc);
295					parser.state.module.addDependency(dep);
296	
297					parser.walkExpression(expr.arguments[2]);
298					return true;
299				});
300	
301			// Self reference //
302	
303			/**
304			 * @param {Expression | Super} expr expression
305			 * @param {CommonJSDependencyBaseKeywords} base commonjs base keywords
306			 * @param {string[]} members members of the export
307			 * @param {CallExpression=} call call expression
308			 * @returns {boolean | void} true, when the expression was handled
309			 */
310			const handleAccessExport = (expr, base, members, call) => {
311				if (HarmonyExports.isEnabled(parser.state)) return;
312				if (members.length === 0) {
313					bailout(
314						`${base} is used directly at ${formatLocation(
315							/** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc)
316						)}`
317					);
318				}
319				if (call && members.length === 1) {
320					bailoutHint(
321						`${base}${propertyAccess(
322							members
323						)}(...) prevents optimization as ${base} is passed as call context at ${formatLocation(
324							/** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc)
325						)}`
326					);
327				}
328				const dep = new CommonJsSelfReferenceDependency(
329					/** @type {Range} */ (expr.range),
330					base,
331					members,
332					Boolean(call)
333				);
334				dep.loc = /** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc);
335				parser.state.module.addDependency(dep);
336				if (call) {
337					parser.walkExpressions(call.arguments);
338				}
339				return true;
340			};
341			parser.hooks.callMemberChain
342				.for("exports")
343				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) =>
344					handleAccessExport(expr.callee, "exports", members, expr)
345				);
346			parser.hooks.expressionMemberChain
347				.for("exports")
348				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) =>
349					handleAccessExport(expr, "exports", members)
350				);
351			parser.hooks.expression
352				.for("exports")
353				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr) => handleAccessExport(expr, "exports", []));
354			parser.hooks.callMemberChain
355				.for("module")
356				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
357					if (members[0] !== "exports") return;
358					return handleAccessExport(
359						expr.callee,
360						"module.exports",
361						members.slice(1),
362						expr
363					);
364				});
365			parser.hooks.expressionMemberChain
366				.for("module")
367				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
368					if (members[0] !== "exports") return;
369					return handleAccessExport(expr, "module.exports", members.slice(1));
370				});
371			parser.hooks.expression
372				.for("module.exports")
373				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr) =>
374					handleAccessExport(expr, "module.exports", [])
375				);
376			parser.hooks.callMemberChain
377				.for("this")
378				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
379					if (!parser.scope.topLevelScope) return;
380					return handleAccessExport(expr.callee, "this", members, expr);
381				});
382			parser.hooks.expressionMemberChain
383				.for("this")
384				.tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr, members) => {
385					if (!parser.scope.topLevelScope) return;
386					return handleAccessExport(expr, "this", members);
387				});
388			parser.hooks.expression.for("this").tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr) => {
389				if (!parser.scope.topLevelScope) return;
390				return handleAccessExport(expr, "this", []);
391			});
392	
393			// Bailouts //
394			parser.hooks.expression.for("module").tap(PLUGIN_NAME, (expr) => {
395				bailout();
396				const isHarmony = HarmonyExports.isEnabled(parser.state);
397				const dep = new ModuleDecoratorDependency(
398					isHarmony
399						? RuntimeGlobals.harmonyModuleDecorator
400						: RuntimeGlobals.nodeModuleDecorator,
401					!isHarmony
402				);
403				dep.loc = /** @type {DependencyLocation} */ (expr.loc);
404				parser.state.module.addDependency(dep);
405				return true;
406			});
407		}
408	}
409	
410	module.exports = CommonJsExportsParserPlugin;
```

**`lib/dependencies/CommonJsRequireContextDependency.js`** — CommonJsRequireContextDependency(class), ContextDependency(constant), constructor(method), type(method), serialize(method), deserialize(method)

```javascript

6	"use strict";
7	
8	const makeSerializable = require("../util/makeSerializable");
9	const ContextDependency = require("./ContextDependency");
10	const ContextDependencyTemplateAsRequireCall = require("./ContextDependencyTemplateAsRequireCall");
11	
12	/** @typedef {import("../javascript/JavascriptParser").Range} Range */
13	/** @typedef {import("../serialization/ObjectMiddleware").ObjectDeserializerContext} ObjectDeserializerContext */
14	/** @typedef {import("../serialization/ObjectMiddleware").ObjectSerializerContext} ObjectSerializerContext */
15	/** @typedef {import("./ContextDependency").ContextDependencyOptions} ContextDependencyOptions */
16	
17	class CommonJsRequireContextDependency extends ContextDependency {
18		/**
19		 * @param {ContextDependencyOptions} options options for the context module
20		 * @param {Range} range location in source code
21		 * @param {Range | undefined} valueRange location of the require call
22		 * @param {boolean | string } inShorthand true or name
23		 * @param {string} context context
24		 */
25		constructor(options, range, valueRange, inShorthand, context) {
26			super(options, context);
27	
28			this.range = range;
29			this.valueRange = valueRange;
30			// inShorthand must be serialized by subclasses that use it
31			this.inShorthand = inShorthand;
32		}
33	
34		get type() {
35			return "cjs require context";
36		}
37	
38		/**
39		 * @param {ObjectSerializerContext} context context
40		 */
41		serialize(context) {
42			const { write } = context;
43	
44			write(this.range);
45			write(this.valueRange);
46			write(this.inShorthand);
47	
48			super.serialize(context);
49		}
50	
51		/**
52		 * @param {ObjectDeserializerContext} context context
53		 */
54		deserialize(context) {
55			const { read } = context;
56	
57			this.range = read();
58			this.valueRange = read();
59			this.inShorthand = read();
60	
61			super.deserialize(context);
62		}
63	}
64	
65	makeSerializable(
66		CommonJsRequireContextDependency,
67		"webpack/lib/dependencies/CommonJsRequireContextDependency"
68	);
69	
70	CommonJsRequireContextDependency.Template =
71		ContextDependencyTemplateAsRequireCall;
72	
73	module.exports = CommonJsRequireContextDependency;
```

**`lib/dependencies/CommonJsRequireDependency.js`** — CommonJsRequireDependency(class), ModuleDependency(constant), constructor(method), type(method), category(method)

```javascript
1	/*
2		MIT License http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php

5	
6	"use strict";
7	
8	const makeSerializable = require("../util/makeSerializable");
9	const ModuleDependency = require("./ModuleDependency");
10	const ModuleDependencyTemplateAsId = require("./ModuleDependencyTemplateAsId");
11	
12	/** @typedef {import("../javascript/JavascriptParser").Range} Range */
13	
14	class CommonJsRequireDependency extends ModuleDependency {
15		/**
16		 * @param {string} request request
17		 * @param {Range=} range location in source code
18		 * @param {string=} context request context
19		 */
20		constructor(request, range, context) {
21			super(request);
22			this.range = range;
23			this._context = context;
24		}
25	
26		get type() {
27			return "cjs require";
28		}
29	
30		get category() {
31			return "commonjs";
32		}
33	}
34	
35	CommonJsRequireDependency.Template = ModuleDependencyTemplateAsId;
36	
37	makeSerializable(
```
